 7.   ORDINANCE –3rd READING – Ordinance appropriating moneys for the City of
      Cheyenne, Wyoming for the various purposes in conducting the municipal government of
      said City and fixing the amount of general and special taxes as part of the revenue required
      to meet the said appropriation, all for the Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2023 and ending
      June 30, 2024.

  ACTION:

 ANNOUNCEMENTS/REPORTS/MOTIONS:

      Announcement of a Public Hearing for the proposed Fiscal Year 2024 budgets for the City
      of Cheyenne and Board of Public Utilities will be held on Monday, June 12, 2023 at 6:00
      p.m. in City Council Chambers, 2102 O’Neil Ave. and via electronic conference meeting.
